title: Do Large Language Models Truly Understand Cross-cultural Differences?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs using the SAGE benchmark, which consists of scenario-based multiple-choice, true/false, and short-answer questions. These questions are designed to test cross-cultural reasoning and incorporate bias-informed distractors such as universalist assumptions, cultural projection traps, and analogy mismatches across different languages and cultural contexts (Chinese, Spanish, and Korean).
